q: Which airport was at the centre of the October 2026 Houthi-Saudi aviation escalation?
e: King Khalid International Airport in Riyadh was the airport at the centre of the October 2026 Houthi-Saudi aviation crisis. Source: Reuters.

q: Which Russian region housed the Yandex data centre reported shut down on 11 October 2026?
e: Yandex said its data centre in Russia's Vladimir region shut down following a drone attack on 11 October 2026. Source: Reuters.

q: What steel capacity target does India's October 2026 draft policy set for 2047?
e: India's October 2026 draft steel policy targets 604 million metric tonnes of steel capacity by 2047. Source: Reuters.

q: Which condition did Zelenskiy attach to Ukraine halting strikes on Russian refineries?
o: Russia ends attacks on Ukrainian energy infrastructure
All sanctions on Russia are lifted
e: On 11 October 2026 Zelenskiy offered to halt Ukrainian refinery strikes only if Russia halted attacks on Ukraine's energy infrastructure. Source: Reuters.

q: Who publicly claimed on 11 October 2026 that Russia and Ukraine had reached an energy ceasefire?
e: On 11 October 2026 Donald Trump publicly claimed a Russia-Ukraine 'energy ceasefire'; neither capital had immediately confirmed it. Source: Reuters.

q: Which German foreign minister reaffirmed Berlin's support for Zelenskiy on 11 October 2026?
e: German Foreign Minister Johann Wadephul reaffirmed Berlin's support for Zelenskiy on 11 October 2026. Source: Reuters.

q: What ceasefire duration did Zelenskiy cite as a condition for organising Ukrainian elections?
e: Zelenskiy conditioned holding Ukrainian elections on Russia agreeing to a 60-day ceasefire. Source: Reuters.

q: Which city hosted the October 2026 WPC Energy Congress despite aviation disruptions?
e: The WPC Energy Congress went ahead in Riyadh on 11 October 2026 despite airport disruptions. Source: Reuters.

q: How many LNG cargoes did Pakistan's Petroleum Division propose for winter 2026 supply?
e: Pakistan's Petroleum Division proposed 22 LNG cargoes for winter 2026 supply, with an estimated cost of about $2 billion. Source: The Express Tribune.

q: Which month did the Kremlin identify for a possible resumption of Russia-Ukraine-US peace talks?
e: Kremlin aide Yuri Ushakov said Russia was willing in principle to resume talks with Ukraine and the United States in November 2026. Source: Reuters.

q: France's 10-year government bond yield reached 5% in October 2026, its highest level since which year?
e: France's 10-year government bond yield reached 5% in October 2026, its highest level since 2002. Source: Reuters.

q: Which IMF official urged India to let its exchange rate act as a first line of defence against the oil shock?
e: IMF Asia-Pacific director Krishna Srinivasan advised India to let the exchange rate act as the first line of defence against the oil shock. Source: Reuters.

q: What 2026 GDP change did the IMF project on 22 October for the Middle East, North Africa and Pakistan regional aggregate?
e: The IMF's 22 October 2026 outlook projected a 1.3% GDP contraction for the Middle East, North Africa and Pakistan regional aggregate in 2026, not for Pakistan individually. Source: Reuters.

q: Which city was announced on 22 October 2026 as host of seven-country ministerial talks including Pakistan?
e: On 22 October 2026, Türkiye announced planned seven-country foreign-minister talks in Istanbul for 23 October, including Pakistan. Source: Reuters.

q: Which oil benchmark touched an intraday high of $112.68 per barrel on 22 October 2026?
e: Brent crude futures touched $112.68 per barrel intraday on 22 October 2026, their highest level since 18 May, according to Reuters. Source: Reuters.

q: Which EU body voted on 22 October 2026 to propose a three-year delay to methane rules for fuel imports?
e: The European Parliament voted on 22 October 2026 to propose a three-year delay to methane rules on fossil-fuel imports; EU government agreement was still required. Source: Reuters.

q: Which malaria vaccine was covered by the roughly 40% price-cut agreement announced by UNICEF and Gavi on 22 October 2026?
e: On 22 October 2026, UNICEF and Gavi announced an agreement to reduce the Mosquirix malaria vaccine price by about 40%, subject to milestones. Source: Reuters.

q: What total R&D funding did the US Commerce Department propose on 22 October 2026 for four power-semiconductor and critical-material firms?
e: The US Commerce Department announced on 22 October 2026 proposed R&D awards of $389 million to four power-semiconductor and critical-material companies. Source: Reuters.

q: Which supply-chain risk prompted TSMC to explore rare-earth-free factory motors, according to Reuters on 22 October 2026?
e: Reuters reported on 22 October 2026 that TSMC was exploring rare-earth-free factory motors in response to Chinese export controls. Source: Reuters.
